s: Which among the following rare natural phenomenon is going to happen in 2024, after 221 (2) Glow Worm Caves 121. S years, in the United States of America?
x: In 2024 the USA saw a double emergence of periodical cicadas: Brood XIII (17-year cycle) and Brood XIX (13-year cycle) came out together, the first such co-emergence in 221 years (last in 1803). Fire tornadoes, glow-worm caves and New York's 'ice volcanoes' are not 221-year events.

src: APPSC 2025 Draughtsman Grade-II (Technical Assistant) In A.P
s: As per State Energy Efficiency Index , 2024 released by BEE ( Bureau of Energy Efficiency ) , which State stood as top performer ?
x: In BEE's State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 (released 29 Aug 2025, for FY 2023-24), Maharashtra ranked first as the Group 1 (>15 MToE) top performer. Andhra Pradesh topped only Group 2 (5-15 MToE), Assam Group 3 and Tripura Group 4; Tamil Nadu and UP did not top.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s: Which of the following is the primary objective of the MISHTI scheme?
o: Increasing mangrove cover and conserving mangrove ecosystems
Regulating commercial activities in coastal zones
x: MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes), launched on 5 June 2023, aims to increase mangrove cover and conserve mangrove ecosystems along the coast and on salt-pan lands, with livelihoods for local people. It is not a fisheries, marine-protected-area or CRZ-regulation scheme, although coastal livelihoods are a side benefit.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s: Which of the following statements regarding Project Snow Leopard is INCORRECT?
o: Project Snow Leopard was launched in 2009.
For conservation, India has identified three large landscapes confined to Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh and Ladakh.
Nanda Devi - Gangotri, in Uttarakhand, is one such landscape.
The Convention on Migratory Species included the snow leopard as a Concerted Action Species under Appendix I.
x: Statement 2 is incorrect: the three snow-leopard landscapes are Hemis-Spiti (Ladakh and Himachal), Nanda Devi-Gangotri (Uttarakhand) and Khangchendzonga-Tawang (Sikkim and Arunachal), so they are not confined to Uttarakhand, Himachal and Ladakh. The project was launched in 2009, Nanda Devi-Gangotri is in Uttarakhand, and CMS listed the snow leopard as a Concerted Action Species under Appendix I (2003), so the other three are correct.
